mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat (room_id, sender_id, message, product_id, chat_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{message}, #{productId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.chat_id AS chatId, c.room_id AS roomId, c.sender_id AS senderId, u.name AS senderName, c.message AS message, c.product_id AS productId, c.chat_at AS chatAt FROM chat c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.sender_id WHERE c.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY c.chat_id ASC
SELECT rm.room_id FROM room_members rm WHERE rm.user_id IN (#{userA}, #{userB}) GROUP BY rm.room_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rm.user_id) = 2 LIMIT 1
SELECT image_path FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND image_type = 'THUMB' ORDER BY sort_order ASC LIMIT 1
